<!-- 请提供尽可能详细的信息 / Please provide as much detail as possible -->

**功能描述 / Feature Description**
<!-- 清晰简洁地描述你想要的功能 / A clear and concise description of what you want to happen -->

**动机 / Motivation**
<!-- 为什么这个功能有价值？/ Why is this feature valuable? -->

**解决方案（可选）/ Solution**
<!-- 清晰简洁地描述你希望看到的解决方案 / A clear and concise description of what you want to see -->

**替代方案（可选）/ Alternatives**
<!-- 描述你考虑过的替代方案 / Describe alternatives you've considered -->

**附加上下文 / Additional context**
<!-- 添加关于此功能请求的任何其他上下文或截图 / Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here -->
